snippet.title: Codename CURE II - Alpha Gameplay Teaser
snippet.description:
The first public gameplay clips of CURE II! We're happy enough with the current state of the game to now show off some teaser footage. (Assault and Pointman gameplay)

Keep in mind these are early alpha builds of the game and a lot is still unfinished; but even here, a lot is being shown off and the game's looking pretty good so far!

Check out our Patreon for more content related to CURE II:
https://www.patreon.com/c/RaptorByte

...and be sure to wishlist on Steam if you haven't already:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2810210/Codename_CURE_II/
